source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 23 (PDF 101-117), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Carbonyl Compounds and Carboxylic Acids) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The structural unit >C=O in organic chemistry is known as the:
(Organic chemistry mein structural unit >C=O ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Structural unit >C=O carbonyl group kehlata hai; aldehydes aur ketones mein yeh hota hai (23.1).

book_ref.quote: the structural unit >C=O is known as carbonyl group

blocks.prompt:
2 Which two classes of compounds are called carbonyl compounds in this chapter?
(Is chapter mein kin do classes ko carbonyl compounds kaha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes aur ketones woh classes hain jin mein carbonyl group hota hai (23.1).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones are the classes of compounds that contain a carbonyl group

blocks.prompt:
3 The most common ketone, found in nail polish removers, is:
(Sab se aam ketone jo nail polish remover mein hota hai, kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se aam ketone acetone (propanone) hai jo nail polish removers mein hota hai (23.1).

book_ref.quote: The most common ketone is acetone, which is found in nail polish removers

blocks.prompt:
4 The smell and taste of bitter almond is due to:
(Karwe badam (bitter almond) ki khushbu aur zaiqa kis ki wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bitter almond ki khushbu aur zaiqa benzaldehyde, C₆H₅CHO, ki wajah se hai (23.1).

book_ref.quote: The smell and taste of bitter almond is due to benzaldehyde

blocks.prompt:
5 According to the chapter, aldehydes are present in:
(Chapter ke mutabiq aldehydes kahan paye jate hain?)

options.text: bahut se masale, phal aur qudrati khushbuein

blocks.explanation: Aldehydes bahut se masalon, phalon aur qudrati khushbuon mein hote hain; ketones dawaon, chemicals aur paint ki sanat mein istemal hote hain (23.1).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are present in many spices, fruits, and natural fragrances

blocks.prompt:
6 Propan-1-ol is warmed with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ and the product is distilled off as it forms. The product is:
(Propan-1-ol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath garam kiya jata hai aur product bante hi distil kar liya jata hai. Product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes primary alcohols ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ya acidified KMnO₄ se oxidise kar ke banaye jate hain (23.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are prepared by the oxidation of primary alcohols with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ or acidified KMnO₄.

blocks.prompt:
7 In the preparation of ethanal from ethanol, the ethanal is distilled off as soon as it is formed in order to:
(Ethanol se ethanal banate waqt ethanal ko bante hi distil kar ke kyun nikal liya jata hai?)

options.text: ethanol ki oxidation ki raftaar barhane ke liye
ise ketone mein badalne ke liye
bani hui pani nikalne ke liye
ta ke is ki mazeed oxidation ethanoic acid mein na ho

blocks.explanation: Aldehyde ko bante hi distil karne se ethanal ki mazeed oxidation ethanoic acid mein nahi hoti (23.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The aldehyde produced is distilled off as soon as it is formed.

blocks.prompt:
8 During the preparation of ethanal, the temperature of the reaction mixture is kept:
(Ethanal ki tayyari mein reaction mixture ka temperature kaisa rakha jata hai?)

options.text: ethanal ke b.p. se zyada magar ethanol ke b.p. se kam

blocks.explanation: Temperature ethanal ke boiling point se zyada magar ethanol ke boiling point se kam rakha jata hai ta ke sirf ethanal distil ho (23.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The temperature is kept above the boiling point of acetaldehyde but below to that of ethanol

blocks.prompt:
9 In the preparation of a ketone from a secondary alcohol, the ketone is not distilled off immediately because:
(Secondary alcohol se ketone banate waqt ketone ko foran distil kyun nahi kiya jata?)

options.text: ketones room temperature par gases hain
in conditions mein ketones carboxylic acids mein tabdeel nahi hote
ketones garam karne par toot jate hain
ketones K₂Cr₂O₇ se alcohols dete hain

blocks.explanation: In conditions mein ketones carboxylic acids mein tabdeel nahi hote, is liye unhein foran nikalne ki zaroorat nahi (23.1.1).

book_ref.quote: since ketones are not converted into carboxylic acids under these conditions

blocks.prompt:
10 Formalin, used for preserving biological specimens, is about a 40 % aqueous solution of:
(Formalin, jo biological specimens mehfooz karne mein istemal hota hai, takreeban 40 % aqueous solution kis ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: HCHO methanal (formaldehyde) hai jo room temperature par gas hai aur 40 % formalin ki shakal mein milta hai (23.1.1; book correction: methanol nahi).

book_ref.quote: It is often encountered as a 40 % aqueous solution called 'formalin'

blocks.prompt:
11 At room temperature, methanal is a gas while other short-chain aldehydes and ketones are:
(Room temperature par methanal gas hai jab ke baqi chhoti chain wale aldehydes aur ketones kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Methanal gas hai; baqi short-chain aldehydes aur ketones liquids hain (23.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Other short-chain aldehydes and ketones are liquids.

blocks.prompt:
12 Oxidation of propan-2-ol with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ gives:
(Propan-2-ol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ketones secondary alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + [O] → CH₃COCH₃ + H₂O (23.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Ketones are prepared by the oxidation of secondary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
13 The two basic types of reactions of carbonyl compounds named in the chapter are:
(Chapter mein carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi reactions kaun se bataye gaye hain?)

options.text: nucleophilic addition reactions and alpha (α) carbon specific reactions

blocks.explanation: >C=O group in ki chemistry chalata hai; do bunyadi reactions nucleophilic addition aur alpha carbon specific reactions hain (23.2).

book_ref.quote: governs the chemistry of aldehydes and ketones

blocks.prompt:
14 In the carbonyl group, the sp² hybridized carbon is bonded to:
(Carbonyl group mein sp² hybridized carbon kis se juda hota hai?)

options.text: oxygen se double bond aur do doosre groups se single bonds
oxygen se single bond aur teen groups se single bonds
oxygen se triple bond aur aik doosra group
do oxygen atoms se double bonds

blocks.explanation: C aur O dono sp² hain; carbon oxygen se double bond aur do doosre groups se single bonds ke zariye juda hai (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: both carbon and oxygen are sp² hybridized

blocks.prompt:
15 The carbonyl group is polar because:
(Carbonyl group polar kyun hai?)

options.text: carbon oxygen se zyada electronegative hai
oxygen zyada electronegative hai, δ⁻ leti hai aur carbon δ⁺

blocks.explanation: Oxygen zyada electronegative hone ki wajah se partial negative charge leti hai aur carbon partial positive (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbonyl group is polar in nature because oxygen, being more electronegative

blocks.prompt:
16 The carbonyl carbon is attacked by:
(Carbonyl carbon par kaun hamla karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: δ⁺ charge ki wajah se carbonyl carbon electrophilic hai aur nucleophiles is par hamla karte hain (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The carbonyl carbon is electrophilic in nature due to its δ⁺ charge

blocks.prompt:
17 Which feature makes the carbonyl carbon uncrowded and supports addition reactions?
(Kaun si khoobi carbonyl carbon ko khula (uncrowded) rakhti hai aur addition reactions mein madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: π bond aasani se toot jata hai aur planar (chapta) shape carbonyl carbon ko khula rakhti hai, jo addition mein madad deti hai (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: planar shape of the group makes the carbonyl carbon uncrowded

blocks.prompt:
18 The C=O double bond undergoes addition reactions mainly because:
(C=O double bond addition reactions kyun karta hai?)

options.text: is ka σ bond bahut kamzor hai
is ka π bond aasani se toot jata hai

blocks.explanation: Double bond addition karta hai kyun ke is ka π bond aasani se toot jata hai (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The double bond can undergo addition reactions because π bond is easily broken down.

blocks.prompt:
19 Aldehydes are more reactive than ketones towards nucleophiles because in ketones:
(Nucleophiles ke liye aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive kyun hain? Ketones mein:)

options.text: carbonyl carbon par zyada positive charge hota hai
do alkyl groups carbon ka δ⁺ kam karte hain aur steric hindrance paida karte hain

blocks.explanation: Ketone mein do alkyl groups ka electron releasing (inductive) effect carbon ka positive charge kam karta hai aur dono groups nucleophile ka rasta rokte hain (steric hindrance) (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are more reactive than ketones for two reasons.

blocks.prompt:
20 The blocking of an attacking nucleophile by the two alkyl groups of a ketone is called:
(Ketone ke do alkyl groups ka hamla karne wale nucleophile ka rasta rokna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ketone ke do alkyl groups hamla karne wale nucleophiles ki raah mein aate hain; ise steric hindrance kehte hain (23.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This is also called steric hindrance.

blocks.prompt:
21 The correct IUPAC name of (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ is:
((CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ ka durust IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C=O aur branch ke qareeb wale sire se numbering karne par 2-methylpentan-3-one milta hai (23.2.1; book correction: 4-methylpentan-3-one nahi).

book_ref.quote: so the compound (CH₃)₂CHCOCH₂CH₃ is 2-methylpentan-3-one

blocks.prompt:
22 Aldehydes and ketones react with hydrogen cyanide to form:
(Aldehydes aur ketones hydrogen cyanide se mil kar kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes aur ketones HCN add kar ke cyanohydrins banate hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones react with hydrogen cyanide to form cyanohydrins.

blocks.prompt:
23 HCN is not used directly in the addition reaction because:
(Addition reaction mein HCN seedha istemal kyun nahi kiya jata?)

options.text: yeh aldehydes se react nahi karti

blocks.explanation: HCN intehai zehreeli gas hai, is liye ise mixture mein NaCN ya KCN aur carbonyl compound mein aahista HCl dal kar banaya jata hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: HCN itself is not used directly as it is an extremely poisonous gas.

blocks.prompt:
24 A slight excess of KCN is added in the HCN addition so that:
(HCN addition mein KCN thora zyada kyun dala jata hai?)

options.text: free CN⁻ ions maujood hon jo reaction shuru aur catalyse karein

blocks.explanation: HCN na nucleophile hai na strong acid, is liye thora zyada KCN free CN⁻ ions deta hai jo reaction shuru karte aur tez karte hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This is done by adding a slight excess of KCN

blocks.prompt:
25 HCN itself does not act as a nucleophile because:
(HCN khud nucleophile kyun nahi hai?)

options.text: is ki nitrogen ke paas electrons nahi
is ke carbon atom par lone pair nahi

blocks.explanation: HCN nucleophile nahi (is ke carbon par lone pair nahi) aur strong acid bhi nahi, is liye CN⁻ bahut kam deta hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: HCN is neither a nucleophile (absence of a lone pair on the carbon atom)

blocks.prompt:
26 About cyanohydrin formation, which statement is correct?
(Cyanohydrin banne ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: cyanohydrin ki yield hamesha bahut kam hoti hai
dono steps reversible hain magar equilibria bahut daayein (right) taraf hain

blocks.explanation: Dono steps reversible hain magar equilibria bahut daayein taraf hain, is liye yield zyada hoti hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Although both the steps involved in cyanohydrin formation are reversible

blocks.prompt:
27 The cyanohydrin used as an intermediate in the manufacture of Perspex is formed from HCN and:
(Perspex banane mein jo cyanohydrin intermediate hai woh HCN aur kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Propanone + HCN se (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN, 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, banta hai jo Perspex ka intermediate hai (23.3.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The Perspex intermediate is the product of propanone and HCN drawn below

blocks.prompt:
28 The product of ethanal with HCN is:
(Ethanal aur HCN ka product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CHO + HCN → CH₃CH(OH)CN, 2-hydroxypropanenitrile (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Ethanal and HCN give 2-hydroxypropanenitrile

blocks.prompt:
29 Nitriles (such as cyanohydrins) on hydrolysis with dilute acid give:
(Nitriles (jaise cyanohydrins) dilute acid se hydrolysis par kya dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitriles dilute acid ya aqueous alkali se hydrolyse ho kar carboxylic acids ya carboxylate ions dete hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Nitriles are hydrolysed by dilute acid or aqueous alkali

blocks.prompt:
30 Reduction of propanal with NaBH₄ gives:
(Propanal ko NaBH₄ se reduce karne par kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se aldehydes primary alcohols dete hain, is liye propanal se propan-1-ol banta hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: aldehydes give primary alcohols and ketones gives secondary alcohols

blocks.prompt:
31 Reduction of butanone (CH₃COCH₂CH₃) with LiAlH₄ gives:
(Butanone (CH₃COCH₂CH₃) ko LiAlH₄ se reduce karne par kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ketones NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se secondary alcohols mein reduce hote hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: With a reducing agent such as NaBH₄ or LiAlH₄

blocks.prompt:
32 In the reduction equations, the symbol [H] represents:
(Reduction ki equations mein [H] kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: NaBH₄ se aane wala reducing H, atomic hydrogen nahi

blocks.explanation: [H] NaBH₄ se aane wala reducing H hai jo equation balance karne ke liye likha jata hai; yeh atomic hydrogen nahi (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Notice that reducing H in brackets [ ] comes from NaBH₄ to balance the equation.

blocks.prompt:
33 The nucleophile that attacks the carbonyl carbon in the reduction by NaBH₄ is the:
(NaBH₄ wali reduction mein carbonyl carbon par hamla karne wala nucleophile kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh reduction carbonyl carbon par hydride ion (H⁻) ka addition hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Since aldehydes and ketones are synthesised by oxidation of alcohols

blocks.prompt:
34 Aldehydes and ketones react with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine to give:
(Aldehydes aur ketones 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine se kya dete hain?)

options.text: wazeh melting points wale orange crystalline (qalmi) thos

blocks.explanation: 2,4-DNPH ke saath condensation se orange qalmi thos bante hain jin ke melting points wazeh hote hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: to give an orange crystalline solids with well-defined melting points

blocks.prompt:
35 The reaction of a carbonyl compound with 2,4-DNPH is of the type:
(Carbonyl compound ka 2,4-DNPH se reaction kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh addition-elimination (condensation) reaction hai; pani kharij hota hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Addition of 2,4-Dinitrophenylhydrazine (Addition – elimination / Condensation Reaction)

blocks.prompt:
36 Which of the following, although it contains the >C=O group, does NOT give the 2,4-DNPH test?
(In mein se kaun >C=O group rakhne ke bawajood 2,4-DNPH test nahi deta?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acids, esters, acyl halides aur amides mein >C=O hai magar yeh test nahi dete (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: which also contain the carbonyl group >C=O do not give this test

blocks.prompt:
37 The orange crystals obtained from ethanal and 2,4-DNPH are:
(Ethanal aur 2,4-DNPH se milne wale orange crystals kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2,4-DNPH reagent hai; orange crystals ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone hain (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: ethanal reacts with 2,4-DNPH to form orange crystals of 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone

blocks.prompt:
38 Besides water, the other product of ethanal with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine is a:
(Ethanal aur 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine ke reaction mein pani ke ilawa doosra product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanal + 2,4-DNPH → ethanal 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone + H₂O; yeh reagent carbonyl compounds pehchanta hai (23.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This reagent is used to identify carbonyl compounds.

blocks.prompt:
39 Ketones are reluctant towards oxidation because:
(Ketones oxidation se kyun katraate hain?)

options.text: oxidation mein C-C bond torna parta hai
in ke carbonyl carbon par hydrogen hota hai

blocks.explanation: Ketone ko oxidise karne ke liye C-C bond torna parta hai, is liye sirf strong oxidising agents hi ketones ko oxidise karte hain (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: because C-C bond has to be broken down during oxidation

blocks.prompt:
40 Which statement about oxidation of carbonyl compounds is correct?
(Carbonyl compounds ki oxidation ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: ketones weak oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain
aldehydes sirf strong oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain
koi bhi acid mein oxidise nahi hota
aldehydes weak aur strong dono oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain

blocks.explanation: Aldehydes weak aur strong dono oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain; ketones sirf strong se (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: whereas aldehydes are oxidized by both weak and strong oxidizing agents

blocks.prompt:
41 Tollens' reagent is:
(Tollens' reagent kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tollens' reagent, ammoniacal silver nitrate, mein aqueous alkaline solution mein silver ions hote hain (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Tollen's reagent also called ammonical silver nitrate solution

blocks.prompt:
42 On gentle warming with an aldehyde, Tollens' reagent gives:
(Aldehyde ke saath halka garam karne par Tollens' reagent kya deta hai?)

options.text: test tube ki deewar par silver mirror (chandi ka aaina)

blocks.explanation: Ag⁺ ions silver metal mein reduce ho kar test tube ki deewar par silver mirror banate hain (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: A silver mirror is formed along the wall of the test tube.

blocks.prompt:
43 Which substance was used with Tollens' reagent to make mirrors for domestic use?
(Gharelu aaine banane ke liye Tollens' reagent ke saath kaun sa substance istemal hota tha?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose (aldehydic sugar) ka dilute solution silver mirror reaction se aaine banane mein istemal hota tha (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: A dilute solution of the glucose (aldehydic sugar) was used to make mirrors

blocks.prompt:
44 In Fehling's test, the brick-red precipitate formed with an aldehyde is:
(Fehling's test mein aldehyde ke saath banne wala brick-red precipitate kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cu²⁺ ions Cu⁺ mein reduce hote hain jo alkaline solution mein copper(I) oxide ka brick-red precipitate banate hain (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: the Cu²⁺ ions are reduced to Cu¹⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
45 In Fehling's solution, the Cu²⁺ ions in aqueous alkaline medium are complexed with:
(Fehling's solution mein Cu²⁺ ions aqueous alkaline medium mein kis ke saath complex hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fehling's solution chamakdar neela Cu²⁺ hai jo alkaline medium mein tartaric acid ke namak se complex hota hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: complexed with salt of tartaric acid

blocks.prompt:
46 Which compound gives a positive Tollens' test?
(Kaun sa compound Tollens' test positive deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf aldehydes Tollens' reagent ko reduce karte hain; ketones yeh test nahi dete (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Ketones do not give this test.

blocks.prompt:
47 Among aldehydes, the only one that gives the iodoform test is:
(Aldehydes mein sirf kaun sa iodoform test deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes mein sirf ethanal aur ketones mein sirf methyl ketones mein CH₃CO- (acetyl) group hota hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Among aldehydes, only ethanal and among ketones, only methyl ketones possess the group CH₃CO-

blocks.prompt:
48 Iodoform, formed in the iodoform test, is:
(Iodoform test mein banne wala iodoform kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CO- wale compounds I₂ aur NaOH se triiodomethane (CHI₃) dete hain jo zard qalmi thos iodoform kehlata hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: a yellow crystalline solid called iodoform

blocks.prompt:
49 Which of the following ketones gives the iodoform test?
(In mein se kaun sa ketone iodoform test deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf methyl ketones (CH₃CO- group) zard iodoform dete hain; butanone methyl ketone hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Hence, the appearance of yellow precipitates will identify the presence of CH₃CO- group

blocks.prompt:
50 In the iodoform reaction of propanone with I₂ and NaOH, the salt formed along with CHI₃ and NaI is:
(Propanone ke iodoform reaction mein CHI₃ aur NaI ke saath kaun sa namak banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃COCH₃ + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + 3NaI + 3H₂O (23.3.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: For acetone (propanone) the salt formed is sodium ethanoate, not sodium methanoate

blocks.prompt:
51 Ethanol gives the iodoform test because:
(Ethanol iodoform test kyun deta hai?)

options.text: is ka CH₃-CH₂-O group ketone ki tarah kaam karta hai
alkali mein iodine pehle ise ethanal mein oxidise karti hai jis mein CH₃-C=O group hai

blocks.explanation: Ethanol mein CH₃-CH(OH)- group hai; I₂/NaOH pehle ise ethanal mein oxidise karta hai jo phir iodoform deta hai (23.3.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Ethanol also gives this test, while methanol does not.

blocks.prompt:
52 Which of the following alcohols gives the iodoform test?
(In mein se kaun sa alcohol iodoform test deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃-CH(OH)- group wale alcohols test dete hain; methanol se CH₃-C=O wala compound nahi ban sakta (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: alcohols having CH3-CH(OH) group give iodoform test

blocks.prompt:
53 Halogens readily substitute hydrogen in aldehydes and ketones at the:
(Aldehydes aur ketones mein halogens kis position par hydrogen ko aasani se badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes aur ketones alpha position par halogens se aasani se substitution karte hain; iodoform test isi par mabni hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones undergo substitution reactions by halogens readily at alpha position.

blocks.prompt:
54 In the Tollens' test, the aldehyde acts as:
(Tollens' test mein aldehyde kis tarah kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehyde Ag⁺ ko silver metal mein reduce karta hai aur khud oxidise hota hai, is liye reducing agent hai (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: These silver ions are readily reduced to silver metal on gentle warming with an aldehyde.

blocks.prompt:
55 In CH₃CHO + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + HCOONa + 3NaI + 3H₂O, the number of moles of NaOH needed for 0.5 mol of ethanal is:
(CH₃CHO + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃ + HCOONa + 3NaI + 3H₂O mein 0.5 mol ethanal ke liye NaOH ke kitne moles chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Mole ratio CH₃CHO : NaOH = 1 : 4, is liye 0.5 × 4 = 2.0 mol NaOH (23.3.2).

book_ref.quote: These compounds react with iodine in the presence of sodium hydroxide

blocks.prompt:
56 The functional group of carboxylic acids is:
(Carboxylic acids ka functional group kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acids mein carboxyl functional group -COOH hota hai (23.4).

book_ref.quote: Carboxylic acids are the organic compounds having the carboxyl functional group (-COOH)

blocks.prompt:
57 The carboxylic acid found in ants is:
(Cheentiyon (ants) mein paya jane wala carboxylic acid kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methanoic acid (formic acid) cheentiyon mein paya jata hai (23.4).

book_ref.quote: methanoic acid (formic acid, found in ants)

blocks.prompt:
58 The acid present in rancid butter is:
(Kharab (rancid) makkhan mein kaun sa acid hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Butanoic acid (butyric acid) rancid makkhan mein hai; ethanoic acid sirke mein (23.4).

book_ref.quote: butanoic acid (butyric acid, in the rancid butter)

blocks.prompt:
59 Lower carboxylic acids have high boiling points because of:
(Chhote carboxylic acids ke boiling points zyada kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote carboxylic acids hydrogen bond banane ki salahiyat ki wajah se zyada boiling point wale liquids hain (23.4).

book_ref.quote: This is due to their ability to make the hydrogen bond.

blocks.prompt:
60 The melting point and boiling point of ethanoic acid given in the chapter are:
(Chapter mein ethanoic acid ka melting point aur boiling point kya diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid 17 °C par pighalta aur 118 °C par ubalta hai (23.4).

book_ref.quote: The melting point of ethanoic acid is 17 °C, and its boiling point is 118 °C.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Acyl chlorides sab se reactive functional derivatives hain, is liye doosre derivatives banane mein istemal hote hain (23.8).

124 Ethanoyl chloride is hydrolysed within a few minutes because its carbonyl carbon:
(Ethanoyl chloride chand minutes mein kyun hydrolyse ho jata hai? Is ka carbonyl carbon:)

options.text: is par O aur Cl dono ki wajah se bara δ⁺ hai
is par koi partial charge nahi

blocks.explanation: Carbon par do bahut electronegative atoms, O aur Cl, use bahut δ⁺ bana dete hain, is liye pani bahut tezi se hamla karta hai (23.9).

book_ref.quote: Hence nucleophilic attack of H₂O on electrophilic carbon is so fast

options.text: sirf aik electronegative atom (Cl) se juda hai, is liye kam δ⁺

blocks.explanation: Ethyl chloride mein carbon sirf chlorine se juda hai, is liye kam δ⁺ leta hai aur pani ka hamla nisbatan aahista hai (23.9).

options.text: Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalise ho kar C-Cl bond ko double bond character deta hai

blocks.explanation: Cl ka lone pair ring ke π electrons ke saath delocalise hota hai, C-Cl mein double bond character aata hai, is liye bond nahi toot-ta (23.9).
